The '''Doldrums system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained the star [[Doldrums]]. It was where [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]], rendezvoused with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] flagship [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] after they [[Ambush at Xobome 6|captured]] the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']] from [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces.<ref name="WS" />
